headline: Recommended 20-year wood pyrolysis power deal at McNeil Generating Station and City Arts lease at 405 Pine Street; postponed tariff changes.
summary: Three residents spoke against the wood pyrolysis project, which passed 4-1 with Councilor Bergman opposed. A consent agenda covered four items, including $40,000 in Community Celebrations grants. The budget-to-actuals update was also postponed until 12/7.
decisions: Approved the November 9, 2026 meeting minutes, unanimously as part of the consent agenda.
Approved a regular meeting schedule through August 2027, unanimously as part of the consent agenda.
Approved allocating up to $40,000 for Community Celebrations sponsorship grants over two grant cycles, unanimously as part of the consent agenda.
Recommended City Council authorization to accept the UVM PREVENT Services Agreement with the Burlington Fire Department, unanimously as part of the consent agenda.
Recommended City Council approval of converting Burlington Electric Department power system and engineering positions, unanimously.
Recommended City Council approval of a 20-year power purchase agreement for a wood pyrolysis demonstration project at the McNeil Generating Station, 4-1.
Recommended City Council approval of renewing and expanding the Burlington City Arts lease at 405 Pine Street, unanimously.
Postponed the City budget update for July 1 to October 31, 2026 until 12/7.
